application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those on the approved plans.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.&nbsp;The Landscaping Scheme shall include a landscape masterplan and full details of both hard and soft landscaping works.<div style="line-height: 20px;"><p style="">The soft landscaping details shall include:</p><ul style=""><li>Planting plans at a scale of not less than 1:100;</li><li>Schedules of plants specifying species, plant sizes, container sizes (at the time of planting), and proposed quantities and/or planting densities;</li><li>A written specification detailing all planting and cultivation works to be undertaken;</li><li>A landscape implementation programme, including proposed timings and dates for all landscaping works.</li></ul><p style="">The hard landscaping details shall include:</p><ul style=""><li>Details and samples/specifications of hard landscaping materials;</li><li>Existing and proposed site levels;</li></ul><p style="">The approved Landscaping Scheme shall be implemented in full in accordance with the approved implementation programme and retained thereafter. Any trees, shrubs, hedges or plants that die, are removed, become severely damaged or diseased within a period of five years from the completion of the landscaping works shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p><br></p></div>
description: Replacement of existing external hard surfaced landscape materials; alterations to existing rear patios and landscaping; replacement shed; creation of outdoor sauna and garden pergola (demolition of outbuilding)
